chunks: And Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān will not be forgiven until the coming year, unless he witnesses ʿArafah."

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, a sacred time of fasting and mercy
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: ʿArafah, the day or place associated with a special occasion of mercy and forgiveness

ai.seo_question: What happens if a person is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān?
ai.summary: This hadith stresses the immense opportunity for forgiveness in the month of Ramaḍān. It warns that one who misses this season of divine mercy may remain without forgiveness until the next year, except through witnessing ʿArafah.
